paper_title: Cosmological bounds on pseudo Nambu-Goldstone bosons
notes: Cosmological bounds on ALP two-photon coupling g (GeV^-1) vs mass m_phi (eV) from BBN, CMB, Neff, EBL, etc. The summary exclusion plot (Fig. 1) is in the m_phi-g plane, so coupling type is AxionPhoton. However, no numerical table is provided and the limits are presented only graphically as multiple overlapping exclusion regions (each with characteristic slope g ~ m^-3/2). The text gives only scattered approximate relations (e.g. g/GeV^-1 >~ 10^-3 (eV/m_phi)^3/2 for the Neff low-mass boundary; DM mass bound m_phi=154 eV). Insufficient digitizable data points to reliably tabulate. Confidence lowered due to lack of extractable numerical limit data.
